text:
nora_sales: Quick request — Saffron wants a 30m live POC next Friday with streaming chat. They plan ~110 concurrent clients, short messages, occasional spikes. Need ephemeral hosted key + temporary QPS bump.

devin_soleng: Can you give RPS estimate + avg tokens? region?

nora_sales: Peak spike ~650 RPS for a few minutes, baseline ~220 RPS. Avg ~70 tokens. Region: us-east-1. They want the key by Wed EOD for infra tests.

tess_sre: Proposal: ephemeral scoped key with burst_qps=700, window 35m (10m warmup) 2026-07-01T16:50:00Z/2026-07-01T17:25:00Z, total_token_limit=80_000_000, streaming=true. Pre-warm redwood-chat-small for fallback.

lina_se: I'll create the scoped key once finance approves token cap. Scopes: /v1/chat, /v1/chat/stream; allowed_models=[redwood-chat-large, redwood-chat-small]; telemetry_tag=saffron-poc. Key auto-expires at window end.

quota-bot: Request recorded: TEMP_HOSTED_BURST by nora_sales for Saffron. Request ID: TR-2112340000. Status: pending_finance.

finance-bot: Please include token estimate and a hard cap to proceed.

devin_soleng: Rough calc worst-case: assume 5m spike at 650 RPS -> 650*70*300 = ~13.65M tokens. Baseline 220 RPS rest of window -> ~220*70*2100 = ~32.34M. Total ~46M; proposed 80M cap includes buffer.

tess_sre: Operational controls: enable KV prefix caching for repeated prompts and set max_response_tokens=140. Route to redwood-chat-small if 95p latency > 800ms or error_rate > 2%. Add dashboard tiles and alerts to #eng-oncall.

lina_se: Example curl for Saffron (replace <SCOPED_KEY>):

```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <SCOPED_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-large","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}' \
  https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/chat/stream
```

finance-bot: Noted. I'll review the estimate and reply by Tue COB. If approved, lina_se will generate the key and update the quota-bot.

nora_sales: Thanks — Saffron expects the key by Wed EOD. Please flag any blockers early. :pray:
